evals.prompt: Searching for our deploy runbook returns junk. Add what's missing to the index.
evals.expected_output: Applies Pattern A: write the missing doc then incrementally reindex, validating retrieval.
assertions: Chooses among three curation patterns: missing doc, weak retrieval (cosine under 0.40), undercovered repo
For a missing doc writes it into a corpus directory and does an incremental reindex
Validates by re-querying and checking the hit improved

evals.prompt: The diagnostic says 150 chunks are missing from the index. Curate the corpus.
evals.expected_output: Stops patching and recommends a full rebuild past the thresholds.
assertions: Recommends a full rebuild via build.py when more than 100 chunks are missing
Also recommends full rebuild for over 20 stale chunks or many chunks under 100 chars
Does not patch chunks one at a time past the threshold

evals.prompt: Add a search box to the settings page.
evals.expected_output: UI feature work unrelated to RAG corpus quality.
assertions: Does not touch the RAG index or build.py
